pipeline.delayed_result_rule: results handled more than 250 ms after acceptance are dropped and reset the pipeline
pipeline.stale_rule: GazePipeline.process marks a timestamp older than 250 ms, in the future or not increasing as stale and resets
pipeline.smoothing: GazePipeline: s + 0.28 * (p - s) per axis; cleared by a null prediction, a gap over 250 ms, a stale result, a model change and every pipeline reset
pipeline.reset_policy: pipeline reset at session start and at each block start (first main-thread moment at or after it); results accepted before a block start and handled after it are dropped before smoothing
pipeline.gaze_actions: clicks, scrolling and dictation suppressed for the whole session (explicit guards)
